description: Derived controlled-language dictionary for the LAAS real-estate profile. The markdown tables in real-estate.md section 3 are authoritative; this file is derived from them. Each term carries exactly one approved meaning and one part of speech (STE-C-04). No term appears in both the nouns list and the verbs list: accept is the verb and acceptance is the noun; disclose is the verb and disclosure statement is the noun. Entries in forbidden with class 'occupant-description' are blocking at every Consequence Tier, including CT0 (real-estate.md section 5.2).

nouns.meaning: The delivery of a signed offer to the offering party. The moment a contract is formed.
An opinion of value stated by a licensed appraiser, with a report date.
The value assigned to a property by a taxing authority for one tax year.
The licensed party responsible for a transaction under a named licence.
The fees and charges payable by a party at settlement, itemised on the settlement statement.
The date on which the transaction settles and the deed is delivered.
The fee payable to a broker, stated as an amount or a rate and a payer.
A broker's estimate of value from comparable sales. It is not an appraisal.
A stated condition that must be satisfied or waived before a party is bound to proceed.
The date and time at which a contingency expires, counted from a named event.
An offer made in response to an offer, which terminates the prior offer.
The instrument that transfers title, effective on delivery and recording.
The document in which a seller states known conditions of the property.
The buyer's own funds applied to the purchase price at settlement.
Funds deposited by a buyer to an escrow account to evidence commitment to a contract.
A recorded right of a named party to use part of the property for a stated purpose.
A recorded claim against a property that limits its transfer or use.
The account held by an escrow holder into which transaction funds are deposited.
The neutral party that holds funds and documents under the escrow instructions.
The interval between acceptance and the closing date.
An agreement signed by all parties and delivered, and therefore binding.
Finished, above-grade living area measured to a named standard.
The written findings of an inspection, with an inspector identifier and a date.
The executed contract that grants possession for a stated term at a stated rent amount.
A recorded claim securing a debt against the property.
The price at which a property is publicly offered on a named listing service.
The unique identifier of a listing on a named listing service.
The published state of a listing on a named listing service.
The number of days between service of a notice and the date it takes effect.
The price stated in an offer by a named party on a stated date.
The parcel or assessor identifier that uniquely names the property.
The contract that states the terms of sale between a named buyer and a named seller.
The periodic sum payable under a lease agreement, with a currency code and a period.
The written standards, published before an application is received, against which a tenant application is evaluated.
Funds held against a tenant's obligations under a lease agreement, refundable on stated conditions.
An amount the seller agrees to credit the buyer at settlement.
The itemised statement of all funds paid and received at closing.
A prospective tenant's submitted request to lease, evaluated against screening criteria.
The title insurer's statement of the conditions on which it will insure title.
A recorded matter that prevents title from being conveyed as agreed.

verbs.meaning: Deliver a signed offer to the offering party, forming a contract.
Change an executed contract by a written instrument signed by all parties.
End a contract under a right stated in that contract.
Sign a document already signed by another party.
Transmit a document to a party by a method the contract states.
Pay funds out of an escrow account to a named party.
State a known condition of the property in a disclosure statement.
Sign and deliver a document so that it becomes binding.
Move a stated deadline to a later date by written amendment.
Publish a property to a named listing service at a stated list price.
File an instrument with the county recorder. This enters the public record and cannot be removed.
Pay or return funds held in an escrow account under the escrow instructions.
Undo a contract from its beginning under a stated statutory or contractual right.
Evaluate a tenant application against published screening criteria and record the result.
Deliver a notice by a legally prescribed method, starting the notice period.
Distribute a listing from a listing service to named portals.
End a lease agreement or a contract prospectively under a stated right.
Compare a claim against an independent source and record the result.
Give up a stated right by a written instrument. The right does not return.
Remove a listing from a named listing service.
Retain part of a security deposit against a stated, itemised obligation.

forbidden.reason: States a preferred household composition.
forbidden.replacement: the bedroom count, the room dimensions, and the floor plan

forbidden.reason: Unverifiable, and read as a proxy for the people who live there.
forbidden.replacement: nothing; state property facts only

forbidden.reason: Assumes an ability.
forbidden.replacement: the measured distance and the named destination

forbidden.reason: States a preferred age group.
forbidden.replacement: the property features that prompted the phrase

forbidden.reason: States a religious preference.
forbidden.replacement: the named amenity, if a party asked for it, without a category

forbidden.reason: States a national-origin preference.
forbidden.replacement: the written screening criteria, applied to every applicant

forbidden.reason: States a familial-status preference.
forbidden.replacement: the lease terms that apply to every occupant

forbidden.reason: States a disability judgement about the occupant.
forbidden.replacement: the measured accessibility features the property has

forbidden.reason: Historic exclusionary vocabulary.
forbidden.replacement: the named amenity or the named association

forbidden.reason: Describes the residents. Steering, whether the intent is favourable or not.
forbidden.replacement: nothing; state property facts only

forbidden.reason: An unverifiable conclusion about a person, and the phrasing read as pretext.
forbidden.replacement: the screening criterion identifier and the applicant's value against it

forbidden.reason: Calendar or business, counted from the signature or from delivery (STE-RE-02).
forbidden.replacement: the number, calendar days or business days, and the starting event

forbidden.reason: The date, the costs, or the process.
forbidden.replacement: closing date, closing costs, or settlement statement

forbidden.reason: The account, the holder, or the period.
forbidden.replacement: escrow account, escrow holder, or escrow period

forbidden.reason: Earnest money, security deposit, or down payment.
forbidden.replacement: the named sum

forbidden.reason: List, offer, appraised, or assessed. Four different numbers.
forbidden.replacement: the named figure, with its source and date

forbidden.reason: Offer, loan, association, or inspection approval. They fail independently.
forbidden.replacement: what was approved, by whom, and on what date

forbidden.reason: Sent, signed, delivered, or binding.
forbidden.replacement: executed contract, or the stage by name

forbidden.reason: A conclusion, not a finding.
forbidden.replacement: the title commitment identifier and each listed exception

forbidden.reason: Does not remove a disclosure duty, though it reads as though it does.
forbidden.replacement: the named contract clause and the disclosure statement

forbidden.reason: A sent notice is not a served notice, and only one starts the clock.
forbidden.replacement: serve, with the method, the recipient, and the timestamp

forbidden.reason: Gross, finished, or gross living area.
forbidden.replacement: the number, the unit, and the named measurement standard

forbidden.reason: Discloses a party's position and is unverifiable.
forbidden.replacement: the list price and the days on market

forbidden.reason: Ambiguous across units (STE-RE-12).
forbidden.replacement: the property identifier and the listing number
